levels.surface: أحمد بن ابي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «عن ابيه محمد بن خالد»: «أبيه» plus a name is one link, the name alone (rule 7); «يرفعه إلى» is the gap, an unnamed link (rule 8)
the Imam is named inside the chain after «إلى», so he is a narrator; the first «ابي عبد الله» (occurrence 1) is inside the name Ahmad's line
